observations: Three photos show a used car engine lying on wooden planks in a workshop or garage.
The engine has a silver valve cover with visible wear and grime.
The front of the engine has a black intake manifold and various hoses and connectors.
The timing belt pulley is visible and appears to be in good condition, with no obvious damage.
The engine block has multiple bolt holes and ports, typical of a V6 or V8 engine.
No visible branding or model numbers are readable on the engine block or components in any photo.
The seller's text claims compatibility with RX350, ES350, IS250, and Camry models from 2008-2015, but no visual evidence supports this.

claims.evidence: No visible branding or model identifiers in any photo to confirm RX350. The seller's text is not proof.
No visible branding or model identifiers in any photo to confirm ES350. The seller's text is not proof.
No visible branding or model identifiers in any photo to confirm IS250. The seller's text is not proof.
No visible branding or model identifiers in any photo to confirm Camry. The seller's text is not proof.

risks.risk: Engine may not be compatible with the claimed models (RX350, ES350, IS250, Camry)
risks.proof: Clear photo of engine block with visible model number or VIN tag, or a photo of the engine installed in a vehicle with matching model/year.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used engine, not as a specific model, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Engine may have internal damage or wear not visible in photos (e.g., cracked block, worn bearings, blown head gasket)
risks.proof: Video of engine running or a compression test report, or a photo of the oil pan and cylinder head for signs of damage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or with unknown condition, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Engine may be stolen or have a black market origin
risks.proof: Photo of the engine's VIN tag or a certificate of origin, or a photo of the engine's serial number and a matching vehicle's VIN.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with a discount for potential legal or ownership issues.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine block showing any model or VIN number.
Photo of the engine's serial number and any tags or labels.
Video of the engine running or a compression test report.
Photo of the engine installed in a vehicle with matching model/year.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
